title: Review proposals (model output of /review Pass 1)
description: The only file the model writes in a /review run (spec 045 ADR-12). Every item names its sources; the source-in-period rule and the two-day rule for themes are checked by lib/review_doc.py against read.json, the section checks (known key, cap, double placement, mark) by lib/review_sections.py. The habits group is computed by lib/review_habits.py and never appears here. Text for the user's own sections enters only through sections, by the row id of a mapped section (spec 046 ADR-1); without a mapping every key is refused.

language.description: The review language the proposals are written in (the setup's review.language).

growth.description: Ignored: review-doc.py write builds the Vault growth group from the created notes and the MOC lists of the read (spec 047 T9.3, F-R3b-4). Kept so a proposals file that still carries it is not refused.

sections.description: Items per mapped section of the user's note (spec 046): key is the row id read.json lists under sections, never heading text.

text.description: The proposal in the review language; a second line becomes a continuation line of the item. Whitespace-only text is rejected (empty-text). A line starting with a heading, checkbox, quote, fence or thematic-break marker is rendered escaped, never as structure.

sources.description: Vault paths or stems of the notes the proposal rests on, as read.json lists them; at least one must be a daily of the period (a weekly note of the period for weekly_only, a monthly note for monthly_only). Only sources that resolve to such a note are rendered as links; any other source is dropped from the links.

mark.description: The month mark (weekly_only, not_in_weekly) or the quarter mark (monthly_only, not_in_monthly) of an item that landed in a section; checked like its group. A weekly_only / monthly_only item rests on that weekly / monthly note.

carried.description: What became of the previous reviews' items this item carries (spec 047 ADR-6); comes only with carried_ids. Which group or mark a value may stand in, and that every carryover id is used exactly once, is checked by lib/review_carried.py.

carriedIds.description: The ids of the carryover.json items this item carries; comes only with carried. Each id must exist in carryover.json, and the item's previous-note sources lie within the sources of its ids (lib/review_carried.py).
